onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/category.schema.json, set ac_jump_style to {{ac_jump_style}}]
Set the jump style to {{ac_jump_style}}. Variable = releasing jump early cuts the arc via abortJump().

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/category.schema.json, set ac_coyote to {{ac_coyote}}]
Set coyote time window to {{ac_coyote}}. Short=80ms, Long=200ms, Off=0ms.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/category.schema.json, set ac_dash_dir to {{ac_dash_dir}}]
Set the dash direction to {{ac_dash_dir}}. Facing=character forward, Input=current stick direction.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/category.schema.json, set ac_jump_buffer to {{ac_jump_buffer}}]
Set jump input buffering to {{ac_jump_buffer}}. On = jump pressed slightly before landing still fires.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/category.schema.json, set at_jump_impulse to {{at_jump_impulse}}]
Set JumpAbility.jumpImpulse to {{at_jump_impulse}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/category.schema.json, set at_jump_cooldown to {{at_jump_cooldown}}]
Set JumpAbility.jumpCooldown to {{at_jump_cooldown}} milliseconds.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/category.schema.json, set at_dash_distance to {{at_dash_distance}}]
Set DashAbility.dashDistance to {{at_dash_distance}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/category.schema.json, set at_dash_cooldown to {{at_dash_cooldown}}]
Set DashAbility.dashCooldown to {{at_dash_cooldown}} seconds.
